...For the Petitioner.
 Mr. K.J. Yusuf,
 Mr. Bolarko Sen.
 ...For the State.
 Mr. S. Banerjee,
 Mr. A. Sinha Roy.
 ...For the Intervening Respondents.
Perused the report filed by the Inspector of Police Bidhannagar Women PS Case No. 05/2024 dated 17 th February, 2024.

It appears therefrom that the investigation of the aforesaid case is complete resulting to filing of the final report vide Bidhannagar Women PS Charge Sheet No. 09/2024 dated 28th June, 2024 under Sections 498A/323/34 IPC and 3/4 D.P. Act.

entities.text: Bidhannagar Women PS Charge Sheet No. 09/2024
entities.label: ORG

sentences.text: The charge sheet has been submitted before the Learned Additional Chief Judicial Magistrate Bidhannagar on 6th July, 2024.
The petitioner is aggrieved by the manner in which the investigation of the subject case has proceeded.

entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: It has been submitted that the statement of the de facto complainant, the petitioner herein, under Section 164 CrPC has not been recorded.
As the charge sheet has already been filed, it will be open for the petitioner to approach the Learned Trial Court for necessary relief.

Let copy of the report be served upon the learned advocates appearing for the respective parties.
The writ petition and the connected application stand disposed of.
Urgent photostat certified copy of this order be supplied to the parties, if applied for, as early as possible.
( Amrita Sinha, J.)
